szoveg_eredeti:
🤝 Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI's first European MSSP design partner.

This partnership gives us early access to a version of Mistral Large 4 optimized for cybersecurity: authorized penetration testing, vulnerability assessment and red teaming.

🎯 Concrete use cases, starting now
→ Penetration testing and technical audits, to explore a wider range of attack scenarios
→ Investigation and incident response, to speed up trace analysis and the reconstruction of attacks

🛡️ AI under human oversight
Access management, traceability, model security testing and human oversight. Critical actions remain the responsibility of our experts.

🇪🇺 Trusted European AI
A European model, running on computing capacity located in Europe. A guarantee of sovereignty for organizations using AI in sensitive contexts.

💬 "Volume, speed, trust: these are the three challenges facing cybersecurity in the age of AI. With Mistral AI, we are building European cyber AI, trained by our experts and operated under their control." Hugues Foulon , CEO of Orange Cyberdefense

🙏 Thanks to Arthur Mensch and the Mistral AI teams, and to our experts who will shape this model with what they see in the field every day.

👉 Read the press release: https://ow.ly/KfXv5102kwo
